phase1.name: Foundation (Weeks 1-4)
phase1.description: Core infrastructure, multiplayer framework, basic game loop

tasks.title: Setup Project Structure and Build Pipeline
tasks.description: Initialize Vite project with TypeScript, configure build for client and server, setup linting and testing frameworks
acceptanceCriteria: Vite project configured for client and server builds
Package scripts for dev, build, test, lint
verificationSteps: Run `npm run dev` - client and server start
Run `npm run build` - both build successfully
Run `npm run test` - sample test passes
tasks.notes: Foundation for all development. Strict TypeScript mode required by quality standards.

tasks.title: Define Project Architecture and Folder Structure
tasks.description: Create folder structure for client, server, shared code. Define module boundaries and architectural patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Shared code for types, constants, utilities
verificationSteps: Confirm shared code compiles for both client and server
tasks.notes: Critical for maintainability. Follow server-authoritative pattern.

tasks.title: Setup Turborepo Monorepo Configuration
tasks.description: Configure Turborepo for client-server monorepo with Vite build tooling. Set up pnpm workspaces, turbo.json task orchestration, and internal package sharing between client and server.
acceptanceCriteria: Turborepo installed and configured with turbo.json
Build pipeline: turbo run build compiles both client and server
Dev pipeline: turbo run dev starts both client and server concurrently
Task caching and dependency graph configured
verificationSteps: Run pnpm install - all workspace dependencies install correctly
Run pnpm build - both client and server build successfully
Run pnpm dev - both client and server start concurrently
Test workspace protocol - import shared types from @bomber-royale/shared
Verify Turborepo caching - rebuild unchanged packages uses cache
Test task dependency graph - server builds after shared package
tasks.notes: Foundation task - must precede all other development. Enables shared types, utilities, and efficient build orchestration. Reference: https://github.com/vercel/turborepo/tree/main/examples/with-vite

tasks.title: Setup Colyseus Server and Room Management
tasks.description: Initialize Colyseus server, create room handler for 64 players, setup WebSocket communication
acceptanceCriteria: Room handler configured for 64 max clients
verificationSteps: Connect 64 test clients - all join successfully
Verify room state syncs to all clients
tasks.notes: Core multiplayer foundation. DEC-014: Server Architecture.

tasks.title: Implement Client-Side Prediction and Reconciliation
tasks.description: Add prediction for local movement, implement reconciliation for server corrections
verificationSteps: Test with 100ms simulated latency - movement feels responsive
Verify server corrections don't cause rubber-banding
Measure input lag - under 100ms for 95% cases
tasks.notes: Critical for responsive feel. DEC-014: Client-side prediction.

tasks.title: Integrate Matter.js Physics Engine
tasks.description: Setup Matter.js on client and server, create physics world with collision detection
acceptanceCriteria: Matter.js integrated on client and server
Physics world created with proper bounds
Physics bodies sync from server to client
Gravity and friction configured for top-down
verificationSteps: Create test physics body - appears on both client and server
tasks.notes: Core physics foundation. DEC-003: Physics object limits.

tasks.title: Implement Physics Object Pooling and Limits
tasks.description: Create object pool for throwables, enforce 30 object limit per sector, implement cleanup system
acceptanceCriteria: Object pooling for crates, barrels, chests
Maximum 30 physics objects per sector enforced
Priority cleanup: oldest objects despawned first
Sector-based culling: objects outside active sectors cleaned
LOD system: physics stops for objects >15 tiles from players
verificationSteps: Test sector culling - objects in inactive sectors removed
tasks.notes: DEC-003: Critical for 64-player performance.

tasks.title: Implement Player Entity and Movement
tasks.description: Create player entity with 8-directional movement, 8 tiles/second speed, WASD + touch controls
acceptanceCriteria: Player entity created with physics body
verificationSteps: Test server validation - speed hacks rejected
tasks.notes: Core movement mechanic. DEC-010: Spawn system depends on this.

tasks.title: Implement Spawn System with Protection
tasks.description: Distributed spawn across 16 sectors, 4 players per sector, 3-tile spacing, 10-second protection
acceptanceCriteria: 64 players distributed across 16 sectors (4 per sector)
Pre-defined safe zones with 3-tile minimum spacing
verificationSteps: Test with 64 players - no spawns within 3 tiles
Verify invulnerability - no damage for 10 seconds
Test spawn distribution - even across sectors
tasks.notes: DEC-010: Spawn system sets match tone.

tasks.title: Implement Melee and Ranged Weapons
tasks.description: Create 14 weapon types with unique stats, implement melee and ranged attacks, damage system
verificationSteps: Verify counterplay - melee beats ranged beats throwables
Verify server validation - no damage hacks
tasks.notes: DEC-006, DEC-009: Core combat mechanics. OQ-001: Damage formula.

tasks.title: Implement Physics-Based Throwing
tasks.description: Allow throwing crates, barrels, chests. Damage = mass × velocity. 30 object limit enforced
acceptanceCriteria: Throw mechanics for all physics objects
verificationSteps: Verify server validation - no speed hacks
tasks.notes: Core mechanic. OQ-001: Need exact damage formula.

tasks.title: Create 4x4 Sector Map System
tasks.description: Generate 4x4 grid of sectors, implement hybrid fixed/procedural generation
verificationSteps: Verify 64 players can spawn without overlap
tasks.notes: DEC-001: Hybrid map generation core to gameplay.

tasks.title: Implement Destructible Environment
tasks.description: Soft blocks destructible, hard blocks indestructible, crates/barrels as physics objects
acceptanceCriteria: Soft blocks destroyable with all weapons
Crates, barrels, chests as physics bodies
verificationSteps: Test destroying soft blocks - breaks correctly
Test physics objects - spawn with physics
Verify destruction syncs to all clients
tasks.notes: Core map interaction.

tasks.title: Implement Shrinking Zone System
tasks.description: 12-minute match with 5 closure phases. 30-second warning, 10-second closure, 10 damage/second
verificationSteps: Play full match - all phases trigger correctly
tasks.notes: DEC-007, DEC-011: Core pacing mechanic. OQ-002: Closure mechanics.

tasks.title: Implement Looting and Inventory System
tasks.description: Loot from crates, barrels, chests. Inventory management. Loot rarity system
acceptanceCriteria: Three container types: crates, barrels, chests
Loot by rarity: Common (60%), Uncommon (30%), Rare (10%)
Loot drops on death (OQ-004: design decision needed)
verificationSteps: Test all container types - loot spawns
tasks.notes: Core progression. OQ-004: Death loot rules need decision.

tasks.title: Implement Core HUD and UI
tasks.description: Health bar, weapon display, minimap, zone timer, kill feed, damage numbers
verificationSteps: Test all UI elements - visible and functional
Verify mobile layout - readable on small screens
tasks.notes: DEC-012: Visual language applies to all UI.

tasks.title: Implement Mobile Touch Controls
tasks.description: Virtual joysticks for movement and aiming, on-screen buttons for actions, aim assist
acceptanceCriteria: On-screen buttons for attack, throw, interact
Aim assist (OQ-006: strength to be determined)
verificationSteps: Test aim assist - helpful but not overpowered
tasks.notes: DEC-004: Cross-platform requires good touch controls.

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Modal Damage Feedback
tasks.description: Directional indicator, damage numbers, sound effects, screen shake, kill cam
acceptanceCriteria: Unique sound effects per damage type
verificationSteps: Test all damage types - feedback is clear
Test in chaotic situations - can identify source
Test kill cam - replay is accurate
tasks.notes: DEC-008: Critical for retention. OQ-007: Kill cam implementation.

tasks.title: Implement Audio System
tasks.description: Distinct sounds for all actions, stereo positioning, volume attenuation, priority capping
acceptanceCriteria: Distinct sounds for each damage type
Separate sliders for music, SFX, voice
Music layers for lobby, drop, combat, endgame
verificationSteps: Test all sounds - distinct and clear
Test with 64 players - capped at 10 SFX
tasks.notes: DEC-013: Audio as information channel.

tasks.title: Implement Performance Optimizations
tasks.description: Object pooling, sprite atlases, LOD system, sector culling for 60/30 FPS target
acceptanceCriteria: Object pooling for all frequent objects
tasks.notes: Design Pillar: Sustainable Performance.

tasks.title: Optimize Network Bandwidth
tasks.description: State delta compression, efficient serialization, priority-based updates for <20KB/sec target
verificationSteps: Test priority updates - critical info sent first
tasks.notes: Critical for 64-player scalability.

tasks.title: Implement Accessibility Features
tasks.description: Shape + color visual language, colorblind filters, high contrast mode, mono audio
verificationSteps: Test all elements - shape + color distinct
tasks.notes: DEC-012: Accessibility requirement.

tasks.title: Setup CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Configure automated builds, tests, and deployments
verificationSteps: Push to main - build and test
tasks.notes: Quality infrastructure.

tasks.title: Implement Automated Testing Suite
tasks.description: Unit tests for core logic, integration tests for server, E2E tests with Playwright
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests for core game logic
tasks.notes: Quality standard requirement.

tasks.title: Multiplayer Combat Testing
tasks.description: Test combat scenarios with multiple players, verify damage resolution, test edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: Test network edge cases (latency, packet loss)
verificationSteps: Run combat tests - all scenarios pass
Test with real players - feels fair
Test with high latency - still playable
tasks.notes: Critical for combat integrity.

tasks.title: Weapon and Combat Balancing
tasks.description: Tune all 14 weapons for balance, adjust TTK, verify counterplay effectiveness
verificationSteps: Test skilled vs unskilled - skill wins
tasks.notes: OQ-001: Damage formula needs to be finalized first.

tasks.title: Implement Cosmetic-Only Battle Pass
tasks.description: Free and premium battle pass, cosmetic shop, currency system
acceptanceCriteria: Free battle pass with basic rewards
Premium battle pass ($9.99) with all rewards
tasks.notes: DEC-005: Cosmetic-only monetization. OQ-015: Customization scope.

tasks.title: Implement New Player Onboarding
tasks.description: Mandatory tutorial, bot matches, tooltips, hints
tasks.notes: DEC-015: Critical for new player retention.

tasks.title: Implement Anti-Cheat Measures
tasks.description: Server validation, position checks, rate limiting, player reporting
tasks.notes: OQ-013: Anti-cheat requirements. Critical for competitive integrity.

tasks.title: Implement Matchmaking and Queue System
tasks.description: Unified player pool, input-based grouping, cross-input matching after timeout
verificationSteps: Test matchmaking - groups by input type
tasks.notes: DEC-004: Cross-platform strategy. OQ-003: Queue modes decision needed.
